serviceIdentification.serviceDescription:
ComplySyncATO is a Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) Governance, Risk, and Compliance (GRC) automation platform designed to support continuous authorization and monitoring activities within cloud environments. The Cloud Service Offering (CSO) enables organizations to manage compliance posture through automated validation, evidence collection, and reporting aligned with FedRAMP 20x requirements.

ComplySyncATO integrates with cloud services to collect operational data and supports integration with external systems and service providers, enabling aggregation of compliance data and a unified view of compliance posture across multiple environments. The service is designed to support low to moderate impact systems and enables organizations to demonstrate continuous security compliance in machine-readable formats such as OSCAL, JSON, and XML, as well as human-readable formats.
